title: Governance
structure:
The .content block (padding 22px 30px) holds four siblings in order.

1) .subnav (navy-100 pill tray, width fit-content, margin-bottom 18px) with three .subnav-item children in order: "Notices", "Meetings", "Elections" — the third carries .active.

2) .lifecycle-card (white, 1px navy-100 border, radius 16, padding 20px 22px, margin-bottom 20px). Inside: .lc-top (flex, space-between, align-items flex-start, margin-bottom 18px) containing an unclassed <div> wrapping .lc-title "Phoenix Park Village 1 — 2026 Election" and .lc-sub "Ballot A (Community Executive) & Ballot B (Phase Leadership) · Returning Officer: Delroy Samuels", then .stage-badge "Nominations Open" (amber-500 pill). Next .stepper (flex, align-items flex-start) with NINE .step children in order: (a) .step.done → .step-dot.done containing a checkmark polyline svg, .step-lbl "Draft"; (b) .step.current → .step-dot.current containing a filled circle svg, .step-lbl "Nominations Open"; (c–i) plain .step → .step-dot.upcoming (empty div) with .step-lbl values "Nominations Closed", "Candidate Vetting", "Campaign Period", "Voting Open", "Voting Closed", "Tally", "Certified & Published". Connector lines come from .step:not(:last-child):after. Then .stat-row (flex, gap 14, margin-top 20, padding-top 18, border-top 1px navy-100) with four .stat-box, each .sv over .sl: "14"/"POSITIONS CONFIGURED", "22"/"CANDIDATES NOMINATED", "3 days"/"UNTIL NOMINATIONS CLOSE", "450"/"ELIGIBLE HOUSEHOLDS".

3) An unclassed <div style="display:flex;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;"> holding .btn-outline-sm (span only, no svg) "Review nominations (5 pending)" and .btn-primary-sm with inline style margin-left:auto (span only, no svg) "Close nominations early".

4) An unclassed white card <div style="background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--navy-100);border-radius:16px;padding:6px 18px;"> holding five .position-row: "Chairman" + .pos-seats "1 seat" + .pos-cand "3 nominated"; "Vice Chairman" + "3 seats" + "5 nominated"; "Secretary" + "1 seat" + "2 nominated"; "Treasurer" + "1 seat" + "2 nominated"; "Phase 2 · Phase Lead" + .pos-scope "Phase-scoped" (amber pill, replaces .pos-seats) + .pos-cand "2 nominated".
domain_needs: election.title = "Phoenix Park Village 1 — 2026 Election" (community name + election year)
election.year = 2026 (appears in the URL path /governance/elections/2026)
election.ballot_config — two named ballots: "Ballot A (Community Executive)" and "Ballot B (Phase Leadership)"; needs ballot.code (A/B) and ballot.name
election.returning_officer_name = "Delroy Samuels" (link to user; also the signed-in sidebar user with role "Secretary")
election.current_stage = "Nominations Open" (drives .stage-badge text)

election_stage.sequence — ordered lifecycle of exactly 9 stages with sort order: Draft(1), Nominations Open(2), Nominations Closed(3), Candidate Vetting(4), Campaign Period(5), Voting Open(6), Voting Closed(7), Tally(8), Certified & Published(9)
election_stage.state ∈ done | current | upcoming (derived by comparing stage.sequence to election.current_stage sequence)
election.positions_configured_count = 14 (DERIVED: count of election_position rows for this election)
election.candidates_nominated_count = 22 (DERIVED: count of nomination rows, presumably all statuses)
election.days_until_nominations_close = "3 days" (DERIVED from election.nominations_close_at minus today; rendered as "N days")
election.eligible_households_count = 450 (DERIVED: count of households eligible to vote; same 450 denominator reappears on screen 11 turnout)
election.pending_nomination_count = 5 (DERIVED: count of nominations with status = pending review; surfaced inside the button label "Review nominations (5 pending)")
election.allow_close_nominations_early = true (action availability while stage = Nominations Open)
election_position.name — "Chairman", "Vice Chairman", "Secretary", "Treasurer", "Phase 2 · Phase Lead"
election_position.seat_count — 1, 3, 1, 1 (rendered "1 seat" singular / "3 seats" plural, so pluralisation is derived)

election_position.scope ∈ estate | phase — phase-scoped positions render the amber .pos-scope chip "Phase-scoped" INSTEAD of the .pos-seats chip, and the position name is prefixed with the phase, e.g. "Phase 2 · Phase Lead"
election_position.phase_id — for phase-scoped positions (Phase 2)

election_position.nominated_count — 3, 5, 2, 2, 2 (DERIVED: count of nominations per position; the five rows shown sum to 14, which is LESS than the 22 total nominated and fewer than the 14 configured positions, so this list is a partial/top-N view, not the full position set)
election_position.sort_order — display order Chairman, Vice Chairman, Secretary, Treasurer, then phase-scoped rows last
governance_subnav sections: Notices, Meetings, Elections (Elections active for this route)
export.minutes action available from the Governance topbar
